steps.en: Clone the repo and copy the skill folder into Codex's skills directory
steps.zh: 克隆仓库，把 skill 子目录拷进 Codex 的 skills 目录

steps.en: Paste the article into Codex and call the skill
steps.zh: 把文章贴进 Codex，调用这个 skill
steps.code: Use $ian-xiaohei-illustrations 把下面这篇文章生成 4 张小黑怪诞正文配图。

steps.en: Reads the text and proposes a shot list: one cognitive anchor per picture
steps.zh: 先读正文给出 shot list：每张图只挑一个认知锚点

steps.en: Renders each shot one by one through the host agent's built-in image model
steps.zh: 逐张调用宿主 agent 内置图像模型渲染手绘线稿

steps.en: If the Chinese annotations come out garbled, cut annotation words and regenerate
steps.zh: 批注出错字就减少标注词，重新生成

steps.en: Checks each PNG against the QA checklist and saves it under the article's assets dir
steps.zh: 按 QA 清单逐张检查 PNG，存入文章配图目录

value.en: A whole article illustrated in one consistent hand-drawn voice, without writing a fresh prompt per image
value.zh: 整篇文章用同一套手绘语言配图，不必逐张手写提示词

sources: README.md main @ 2026-09 (retrieved 2026-09-28): 安装 section verbatim 'git clone https://github.com/helloianneo/ian-xiaohei-illustrations.git' and 'cp -R ./ian-xiaohei-illustrations "${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/"'; 怎么用 section verbatim 'Use $ian-xiaohei-illustrations 把下面这篇文章生成 4 张小黑怪诞正文配图。'; 它会产出什么 section verbatim 'assets/<article-slug>-illustrations/'; 注意事项: 中文错字严重时优先减少标注词并重生成
